english.title: Vessel owner / representative fail to inform authority of inspector's notification under reg 12(2)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Merchant Shipping Technical Requirements for Inland Waterway Vessels Regulations 2010

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the owner of]_
(B)_[a representative of **(..SPECIFY OWNER..), the owner of]_

**(..SPECIFY VESSEL..) following an inspection of which under regulation 12(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Technical Requirements for Inland Waterway Vessels) Regulations 2010 an inspector

(C)_[had found that a certificate required by those regulations to be carried on board the vessel was invalid,]_
(D)_[considered that the vessel did not satisfy the requirements set out in the certificate required by those regulations,]_

and notified you accordingly, failed, within seven days beginning with the date of being notified as set out in regulation 12(2) of those regulations, to inform **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the authority which

(E)_[issued]_
(F)_[last renewed]_

the certificate of that notification
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 13(3) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping (Technical Requirements for Inland Waterway Vessels) Regulations 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
owner of vessel or his/her representative
failed to notify renewal / issuing authority in 7 days of notification
following inspector finding certificate invalid or vessel did not satisfy certificate requirements
